text:
alex: Quick ping — opened PR #8340 that updates the kernel selector and default dynamic-batching config in the runtime. Need runtime + infra + security eyes before we merge next Wed 10:00 PT. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/8340 TL;DR: reduces tail latency for short seqs, changes kernel fallback order. Risk: possible ~300MB mem bump on older GPUs. cc @maria @jonathan @eva @sarah

maria: On it. Can you add a tiny reproducer and a note on how to toggle the fallback locally? Also add a flag check in the test harness: `--enable-kernel-fallback` so QA can exercise both paths.

alex: Added unit + perf tests to the PR and a small repro. Local run command: ```make test-batching && python tests/perf/run_repro.py --gpu 16 --seq 128``` I also pushed a commit that documents the flag and behavior. Perf summary attached in PR.

jonathan: Infra question — does this require any driver/CUDA min version changes or new kernel modules? From the code it looks like only userland selection changes, but the mem footprint worst-case increases ~300MB. If confirmed, we'll need to bump node pool autoscaler thresholds and possibly node labels for the canary pool.

sarah: For rollout: prefer 10% traffic for 24h canary, monitor p50/p95/p99 and OOMs. I can create the canary policy in Console once approvals are in. Also let me know which model endpoints to include in the canary.

eva: Security quick Q — kernel selector touches native libs. Confirming: no rpath/LD_LIBRARY_PATH changes, no changes to container capabilities, and no added privileged syscalls? If yes, I'll do a light review and SCA follow-up.

alex: Confirmed — no rpath changes, container tweaks limited to a glibc upgrade and an opt-in runtime flag. No new capabilities. I pushed a tiny commit to clarify. Perf logs in PR show low variance.

infra-bot: CI: build ✓, unit tests ✓, perf smoke ✓. Perf artifacts: https://ci.redwood-inference/jobs/8340/artifacts

security-bot: SCA: no high CVEs. Medium item: libX 1.2.3 flagged (already whitelisted by distro) — full report: https://sca.redwood-inference/reports/8340

maria: Left inline comments about the fallback order and one nit on a comment. Functionally LGTM once I see the tiny test harness change.

jonathan: Will review infra bits and the autoscaler implications. I can approve infra-side, but I will open a follow-up change to bump autoscaler buffer from 10% -> 15% for the affected node pool.

alex: Thanks — once @maria approves I'll schedule merge Tue 18:00 UTC to allow a 24h canary before Wed 10:00 PT. Rollback plan: revert commit abc123 (branch: revert/pr-8340) and re-deploy previous kernel selector.

sarah: I'll create the canary and dashboards now (10% traffic -> 24h). Will post links to dashboards and alert thresholds here.

eva: Security: quick manual glance complete, no new privileges. Approve pending final SCA green on the release artifact.

alex: Merging blocked until runtime + infra + security approvals — pinging for final checks.

maria: :shipit: Approved (runtime) — small test added as requested.

jonathan: Approved (infra). I added a note on the autoscaler PR.

eva: Final security: approved. :white_check_mark:

alex: Great — I'll merge in ~15m and kick off the canary. Posting merge/rollback steps after deploy. Thanks everyone! :thumbsup:

infra-bot: deploy-bot: PR #8340 merged by alex at 1792004810. Canary started (10% traffic). Monitoring: https://console.redwood-inference/canaries/8340
